rows.corpus_definition: A general word for objects or things.
rows.example_en: Please clear your stuff off the table.

rows.corpus_definition: a particular way of doing or making something
rows.example_en: That dress is a very popular style this year.

rows.corpus_definition: to pull liquid or air into your mouth using your lips
rows.example_en: The baby sucks milk from the bottle easily.

rows.corpus_definition: to be right or good for someone
rows.example_en: That color does not really suit you.

rows.corpus_definition: matching jacket and trousers worn for formal business or events
rows.example_en: He wore a blue suit to the meeting.

rows.corpus_definition: To help or encourage someone you like.
rows.example_en: My family will support me in my new job.

rows.corpus_definition: salty liquid that comes out of your skin when hot or nervous
rows.example_en: Sweat dripped down his face after the run.

rows.corpus_definition: To clean a floor using a long brush.
rows.example_en: I need to sweep the kitchen floor today.

rows.corpus_definition: to move back and forth; also a seat hanging on ropes for children
rows.example_en: The children loved to swing in the park.

rows.corpus_definition: To complete a test to show your knowledge.
rows.example_en: I have to take an exam tomorrow morning.

rows.corpus_definition: To join an activity or event with others.
rows.example_en: Will you take part in the school competition?
